facts.fact: L'Union reports that in January 2017 ANINF sent agents to Franceville to check it was interconnected to the Gabonese national backbone network, as it had done at Mouila and Oyem in 2015.

GAB.note: Only a 2015-2017 ANINF interconnection check is mentioned, before the study window; no statement on who runs government systems.
